question: Which clinic for laser hair removal?
why: Doctor-led, a fixed price per session, and a free test patch this month.

options.name: Lumen Skin Clinic
options.summary: Doctor-led clinic using a diode laser suited to darker skin.
cons: Evening slots book out two weeks ahead
options.deciding: Can you make a weekday morning slot?

options.name: City Laser
options.summary: Cheaper chain studio; trained technicians, no doctor on site.
cons: Package prices only; single sessions not listed

options.name: Home IPL device
options.summary: One-off cost; only works on light skin with dark hair.
options.deciding: Is your hair darker than your skin?

options.name: Beauty Bar
options.summary: Uses an older IPL machine not suited to darker skin.
